__doc: Decodes every short code used in the system. Every explain envelope title is resolved through this glossary.

IC.technical: Maps organization to a 10-industry taxonomy with sub-industry classification.

RSS.technical: Weighted score (0-100) reflecting how much regulatory attention an organization's data practices attract.

PGMS.technical: Weighted score (0-100) measuring the breadth and depth of privacy governance infrastructure.

OSI.technical: Weighted score (0-100) reflecting organizational capacity for privacy governance.

DSI.technical: Weighted score (0-100) measuring sensitivity of data categories processed.

EHP.technical: Classification (Clean/Enforcement-Adjacent/Enforcement) based on regulatory enforcement records.

AIGMS.technical: Weighted score (0-100) measuring AI/automated decision-making disclosure maturity.

F-001.technical: Weighted sum of authority, freshness, completeness, and extraction confidence.

F-002.technical: Sum of Jurisdiction Weight x Regulator Priority Weight x Disclosure Severity x Enforcement Frequency across all regulators, normalized 0-100.

F-003.technical: Gap between this organization and the weighted 75th percentile of its peer cohort.

F-004.technical: Cosine similarity between clause embeddings and enforcement record embeddings, weighted by regulator priority and enforcement frequency.

F-005.technical: Ratio of disclosure elements present to expected, minus ambiguity and missing-category penalties.

F-006.technical: Product of completeness, clarity, specificity, and explainability factors, scaled to 0-100.

F-007.technical: Ratio of AI-related clause depth to expected controls, minus AI ambiguity penalty.

F-008.technical: Weighted sum of correlated domain risks with a correlation multiplier, normalized to 0-100.

F-009.technical: Any derived score multiplied by its VCI confidence factor.

F-010.technical: 100 minus the weighted aggregate of all risk dimension scores.

F-011.technical: Weighted percentile rank over normalization-weighted peer population.

F-012.technical: Percentage change between current and prior snapshot score.

F-013.technical: Risk increase x Enforcement Correlation x Priority x Confidence.

F-014.technical: Validated findings ratio x source reliability x NLP confidence.

VCI.technical: Weighted sum of 5 confidence dimensions: NLP 30%, Benchmark 25%, Regulatory 15%, Enforcement 15%, Source 15%. Maps to 5 bands with output guidance.

Very Low.plain: Do not present as definitive; route for review

CR.technical: Clauses about access, deletion, correction, portability, appeal, opt-out, authorized agent.

DC.technical: Clauses about personal information categories, sensitive data, biometric, location, children.

SH.technical: Clauses about service providers, advertising networks, analytics, affiliates, data brokers.

RT.technical: Clauses about specific retention periods, criteria-based retention, or undefined retention.

AI.technical: Clauses about automated decisions, profiling, human review, training data, AI transparency.

SEC.technical: Clauses about safeguards, encryption, breach/incident notification.

TRK.technical: Clauses about cookies, pixels, beacons, preference centers.

XB.technical: Clauses about international transfers, adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses.
